name: ActivityNet-QA
intro: ActivityNet-QA 是面向长视频时空推理的全人工标注视频问答基准。它从 ActivityNet 采样 5,800 个复杂网络视频，每个视频众包编写 10 对问答，共 58,000 对；问题与答案由不同标注者处理，并通过不可答题返工、随机多人多数投票和四引擎翻译一致性检查保证质量。数据提供中英对齐版本。
build_method: ActivityNet分层采样, 众包问答, 独立答案复核, 多引擎翻译质检
eval_feature: 视频问答, 长视频理解, 时空推理
build_method_en: Stratified ActivityNet sampling, crowdsourced QA, independent answer review, multi-engine translation QA
eval_feature_en: Video QA, long-video understanding, spatio-temporal reasoning
intro_en: ActivityNet-QA is a fully human-annotated benchmark for spatio-temporal reasoning over long videos. It samples 5,800 complex web videos from ActivityNet and crowdsources exactly ten QA pairs per video, yielding 58,000 pairs. Separate question and answer annotators, regeneration of unanswerable items, random multi-annotator majority votes, and four-engine translation agreement checks provide quality control. Chinese and English versions are aligned.
drawio_review_note: WORDING reviewed against arXiv:1906.02467v1 Dataset Construction and Evaluation Criteria sections plus official MILVLG/activitynet-qa snapshot 2cf80aeb4e45955e53404e1716d3b9c0b1cbd72f. The diagram adds class-balanced train/validation sampling with random test sampling, question/answer maxima of 20/5 words, yes/no balancing close to 1:1, independent answer review, regeneration, four-engine translation QA, exact accuracy, and WUPS. Multi-annotator majority voting is an optional branch over a sampled portion that rejoins translation; its sample size and annotator count are explicitly marked not disclosed.
